
### Dijkstra's algorithm  {.smaller}


* (AKA best-first search) 
<hr class="vspace" />
* track: 

   * list of visited nodes (initially just source)
   * distance to each node (init. $0$ for source; $\infty$ otherwise)

* repeatedly: 

   * find lowest cost link $A\rightarrow B$ from visited node A
   * update distance to B = min{old distance, distance to A + link cost}
   * mark B as visited (if not already)
